Congress Challenges BJP Candidate's Age in Nandigram Bypoll

The Congress has filed a petition in the Calcutta High Court challenging the age of Hasirani Rath, the BJP's candidate for the Nandigram Assembly bypoll. The party alleges discrepancies in the electoral affidavit submitted by Rath, questioning how she could have cleared Class 10 before her birth.
